verdict.rationale: Independent community reports say LaunchDarkly SDKs download all flags on connection and then stream changes over SSE with minimal latency (comm-2, comm-9). The self-hosted Relay Proxy is documented as part of the delivery architecture (docs-13, docs-32). Missing for 10: first-party docs describing streaming/polling propagation and latency, explicit evidence of seconds-level propagation, kill-switch-specific documentation or hands-on verification.
